explanation: Light controller-driven body (m=0.2) accelerated to ~20 m/s collides with heavier resting body (m=1). In step 10 both are in contact (gap 0.02) and total energy jumps from ~98.9 J to ~348.7 J while recorded controller work is only ~48 J, exceeding E0+work+10%+5 (~122.5 J). Likely cause: impulse/positional-correction contact solver creates energy for large mass-ratio, high-speed impact (and/or controller-work accounting misses work done during contact substeps), ejecting the heavy body at ~22.9 m/s.
